nodes.description: A patent publication titled "Social medical network for diagnosis assistance" describing a method and system for assisting medical diagnosis by exploiting similarity between new medical cases and existing cases and experts in a common embedding space.

nodes.entity_id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance
nodes.description: The title of the patent describing a network-based approach to medical diagnosis assistance using embedding spaces and expert queries.
nodes.id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance

nodes.description: A method that receives a query request including a new medical case, embeds the new case in an embedding space containing existing medical cases and experts, and returns subsets of cases or experts based on computed similarity.

A multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are embedded as multidimensional representations to enable similarity computation.<SEP>A common multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are embedded so that similarity between their representations can be computed.
A medical case submitted by a requester in a query request, comprising a plurality of records relating to a specific patient, which is embedded in the embedding space.
A set of previously stored medical cases embedded in the embedding space, used as candidates for similarity-based retrieval in a query-for-cases.

A set of medical experts embedded in the embedding space based on information such as profiles, coded medical procedures performed, authored articles, and linked stored medical cases, who may be selected to formulate a diagnosis.
A user who submits a query request including a new medical case and selects from a plurality of query types.

A query type that returns a subset of existing medical cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.<SEP>A query type that, when selected, returns a subset of existing medical cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.

A query type that returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.<SEP>A query type that, when selected, returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.

A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from the cost for a query-for-cases.<SEP>A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from and is higher than the cost for a query-for-cases, encouraging requesters to try query-by-cases first.
A structure comprising a set of medical concepts joined by links, each concept corresponding to a dimension in the multidimensional representation, used to embed medical cases and experts.

A representation generated in the embedding space for each existing medical case, each expert, and a new case.<SEP>A representation of a medical case computed based on a medical ontology, where each medical concept corresponds to a respective dimension.
A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology when computing similarity measures.
A medical ontology on which the embedding of medical cases and experts may be based.
Parts of the human body that may be included in the medical ontology.
Biological functions that may be included in the medical ontology.
Medical conditions that may be included in the medical ontology.
Pharmacological substances that may be included in the medical ontology.
A profile of an expert used as information for embedding the expert in the embedding space.
Medical procedures which have been performed by an expert, used as information for embedding the expert.
Articles authored by an expert, used as information for embedding the expert.

nodes.entity_id: Stored Medical Cases Linked To Expert
nodes.description: Medical cases linked to an expert, used as information for embedding the expert.
nodes.id: Stored Medical Cases Linked To Expert

nodes.description: An availability of an expert used, when a query-for-experts is selected, as an additional basis for returning the subset of experts.
A rating of an expert used, when a query-for-experts is selected, as an additional basis for returning the subset of experts.
A number of followers of an expert among users of the system, used as an additional basis for returning the subset of experts.
A database from which documents may be returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and documents embedded in the embedding space when a query-for-cases is selected.
The determination sought for a new medical case, which an expert may attempt to provide.<SEP>A diagnosis formulated by a selected expert for the new medical case provided to the expert.
A payment made to an expert for formulating a diagnosis when a query-for-experts is selected.

A plurality of records relating to a specific patient that make up the new medical case, including laboratory test results, images, symptom descriptions, patient monitor results, diagnoses, prescribed medications and treatments.
Records of laboratory test results that may comprise part of the new medical case.
Medical images that may comprise part of the new medical case.
Descriptions of symptoms that may comprise part of the new medical case.
Results of patient monitors that may comprise part of the new medical case.
Prescribed medications and treatments that may comprise part of the new medical case.

A system comprising memory storing instructions and a processor in communication with the memory for executing the instructions to assist with diagnosis.<SEP>A system comprising memory storing instructions for performing the diagnosis assistance method and a processor in communication with the memory for executing the instructions.
A product comprising a non-transitory recording medium storing instructions which, when executed on a computer, cause the computer to perform the diagnosis assistance method.
A processor that performs at least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing query cost steps of the method.
A medical case, either new or existing, that is embedded in an embedding space to enable similarity-based querying and diagnosis assistance.
A person embedded in the embedding space who can be queried for and to whom a new medical case may be communicated to attempt to provide a diagnosis.
A component in communication with the memory that executes the stored instructions of the diagnosis assistance system.
A component that stores instructions for receiving query requests, embedding medical cases, providing query types, returning subsets, and computing query costs.
A network comprising a diagnosis assistance system and a set of user devices for linking requesters and experts with the system.
Devices in the network used for linking requesters and experts with the diagnosis assistance system.

edges.description: The diagnosis assistance method embeds the new medical case in an embedding space in which existing medical cases and experts are also embedded.
The diagnosis assistance method receives a query request including a new medical case and embeds it in the embedding space.
The diagnosis assistance method provides for the requester to select a query-for-cases among a plurality of query types.
The diagnosis assistance method provides for the requester to select a query-for-experts among a plurality of query types.
The embedding of the new medical case, existing medical cases, and experts is based on a medical ontology.
The diagnosis assistance system comprises memory storing instructions for performing the diagnosis assistance method and a processor for executing the instructions.
The computer program product stores instructions which, when executed on a computer, cause the computer to perform the diagnosis assistance method.
At least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing query cost steps is performed with a computer processor.
The new medical case is embedded in the embedding space alongside existing medical cases and experts.
A set of experts is embedded in the embedding space.
The new medical case comprises a plurality of records relating to a specific patient.
The requester submits a query request that includes the new medical case.
When the query-for-cases is selected, a subset of the existing medical cases is returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.
When the query-for-experts is selected, a subset of the experts is returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.
Experts are embedded based on information including a profile of the expert.
Experts are embedded based on coded medical procedures which have been performed by the expert.
Experts are embedded based on articles authored by the expert.
Experts are embedded based on stored medical cases linked to the expert.

When the query-by-cases is selected, provision is made for a query-by-experts to be performed subsequent to the query-by-cases.
When query-for-cases is selected, a subset of existing cases is returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.

When the query-for-experts is selected, returning the subset of experts is also based on a rating of the expert.
When the query-for-experts is selected, returning the subset of experts is also based on a number of followers of the expert.
When the query-for-experts is selected, the new case is provided to a selected one of the subset of experts for formulating a diagnosis.
When query-for-experts is selected, a subset of experts is returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.

The plurality of records may include prescribed medications and treatments.

The network comprises a system for diagnosis assistance.

The user devices link experts with the diagnosis assistance system.
The processor is in communication with the memory to execute the stored instructions.
The network comprises a set of user devices for linking requesters and experts with the system.
